name: King You of Zhou
role: Last king of the Western Zhou
contribution: A king of the Chinese Zhou dynasty and the last from the Western Zhou.

checks.lead: King You of Zhou (795–771 BC), personal name Ji Gongsheng, was a king of the Chinese Zhou dynasty and the last from the Western Zhou. He reigned from 781 to 771 BC.
